title: search
prompt:
Mobile screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam": search across the study guides and the 2,060-question bank. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
Top: large-title header "Search", then a 48pt tall rounded search field (#182033, 14 radius) with a magnifier icon, the typed query "habendum" and a clear (x) button.
Below the field a row of filter chips: "All 23", "Study guides 9", "Questions 14" (first selected, green tint).
Results grouped under small bold headings "Study guides" and "Questions". Guide results: each row shows the chapter route bullet (blue "A" Legal Issues & Land Title), the section name "Deed clauses and their wording" in bold, and a two-line snippet with the matched word highlighted in a green tinted pill: "The habendum clause ('to have and to hold') defines the estate granted…". Question results: question text snippet with the match highlighted, the topic route bullet, and a small "Practice" pill on the right. Floating tab bar with Study active.
